# Helper pagination

def fetch_all_liked_songs(access_token):
    songs=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-liked_at')
        print('liked_songs page', page_index, 'returned', len(resp) if resp else 0)
        if not resp:
            break
        songs.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>200:
            break
    return songs

liked_songs = fetch_all_liked_songs(spotify_access)
print('Total liked songs:', len(liked_songs))
print('Sample liked songs:', [(s['title'], s['album_title'], [a['name'] for a in s['artists']]) for s in liked_songs[:3]])

# Song library

def fetch_all_song_library(access_token):
    items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        print('song_library page', page_index, 'returned', len(resp) if resp else 0)
        if not resp:
            break
        items.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>200:
            break
    return items

song_lib = fetch_all_song_library(spotify_access)
print('Total songs in song library:', len(song_lib))
print('Sample song_lib:', [(s['title'], s['song_id']) for s in song_lib[:3]])

# Album library

def fetch_all_album_library(access_token):
    items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        print('album_library page', page_index, 'returned', len(resp) if resp else 0)
        if not resp:
            break
        items.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>200:
            break
    return items

album_lib = fetch_all_album_library(spotify_access)
print('Total albums in album library:', len(album_lib))
print('Sample album_lib:', [(a['album_id'], a['title']) for a in album_lib[:3]])

# Playlist library: accumulate song_ids

def fetch_all_playlist_library(access_token):
    playlists=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, is_public=None)
        print('playlist_library page', page_index, 'returned', len(resp) if resp else 0)
        if not resp:
            break
        playlists.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>200:
            break
    return playlists

playlists = fetch_all_playlist_library(spotify_access)
print('Total playlists in playlist library:', len(playlists))
print('Sample playlist titles:', [p['title'] for p in playlists[:3]])

# Validate show_playlist_library song_ids length vs show_playlist for first playlist
if playlists:
    pid = playlists[0]['playlist_id']
    detailed = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_access)
    lib_song_ids_count = len(playlists[0].get('song_ids', []))
    detailed_count = len(detailed.get('songs', []))
    print('Validation playlist_id', pid, 'song_ids_count_in_library', lib_song_ids_count, 'songs_count_in_show_playlist', detailed_count)

playlist_song_ids=set()
for p in playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
        playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
print('Unique song_ids appearing in any playlist (from playlist library):', len(playlist_song_ids))

song_lib_song_ids=set([s['song_id'] for s in song_lib])
album_lib_album_ids=set([a['album_id'] for a in album_lib])
print('Unique song_ids in song library:', len(song_lib_song_ids))
print('Unique album_ids in album library:', len(album_lib_album_ids))

# Filter liked songs
filtered=[]
for s in liked_songs:
    if (s['song_id'] in song_lib_song_ids) or (s['album_id'] in album_lib_album_ids) or (s['song_id'] in playlist_song_ids):
        filtered.append(s)
print('Filtered liked songs count:', len(filtered))
print('Sample filtered:', [(s['title'], [a['name'] for a in s['artists']]) for s in filtered[:5]])
